title: `02443_detach_attach_partition` is flaky
body:
[Stats](https://<redacted-host>/play?user=play#)

https://s3.amazonaws.com/clickhouse-test-reports/json.html?PR=82137&sha=83b2445831e76f06deb8fed98bdee2172939381e&name_0=PR&name_1=Stateless%20tests%20%28amd_binary%2C%20old%20analyzer%2C%20s3%20storage%2C%20DatabaseReplicated%2C%202%2F2%29
Here is data race
query `alter table attach patrition all`
and

comments.author: participant7
comments.body:
My PR adds only cosmetic improvements; no logic has changed.

The test is flaky for parallel replicas, see [check name](https://<redacted-host>/play?user=play#)

The solution is to disable it for parallel replicas altogether. I'll ask devs if my impression is correct.

On how to launch it locally, the instructions are on this page https://clickhouse.com/docs/development/tests#running-a-test-locally

@participant11 recently added a feature to run the same tests as in our CI locally via the `ci` directory. It's worth adding a manual on how to do it to the mentioned page.

comments.body:
I'm able to run the test locally. Now I need to find a way to reproduce the failure

```
#!/bin/bash

set -e

set_env() {
    export CHVER=25.7
    export CHKVER=25.7
    export CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT="docker exec -it clickhouse-01 clickhouse-client"
}

clone_cluster() {
    cd cluster_1S_2R && return 0
    git clone https://github.com/ClickHouse/examples.git
    cp -r examples/docker-compose-recipes/recipes/cluster_1S_2R .
    rm -rf examples
    cd cluster_1S_2R
}

clone_cluster
docker compose up -d

while true
do
    ../ClickHouse/tests/clickhouse-test 02443_detach_attach_partition
done |& tee test.log
```

Here is a proposed fix: add a retry if `ALTER TABLE` fails due to `ATOMIC_RENAME_FAIL` or `TABLE_IS_READ_ONLY` - what do you think? @participant2 @participant11
